page.title: Argumentation and Academic Tone
page.subtitle_html: Argumentation and academic tone - C2 claims, evidence, qualification, and formal argumentative flow.
page.subtitle_text: C2 claims, evidence, qualification, and formal argumentative flow.

blocks.body: {"level":"C2","intro":"Argumentation and academic tone: compact anchors for balanced claims, evidence-based reasoning, and formal conclusions.","rules":[{"label":"Qualified claims","text":"Frame claims with appropriate caution when evidence is partial or contestable.","example":"It can be argued that this policy requires revision."},{"label":"Evidence and reasoning","text":"Connect claims to evidence without overstatement or conversational phrasing.","example":"The evidence suggests that the effect is limited."},{"label":"Academic conclusion","text":"Use therefore, thus, and consequently when the conclusion follows from the argument.","example":"Thus, the claim requires more compelling evidence."}]}

page.title: Discourse Markers And Cohesion
page.subtitle_html: Discourse Markers And Cohesion - C2 connectors for contrast, addition, consequence, sequencing, and stance.
page.subtitle_text: C2 connectors for contrast, addition, consequence, sequencing, and stance.

blocks.body: {"level":"C2","intro":"Discourse markers and cohesion: compact C2 anchors for guiding readers through contrast, addition, result, and stance.","rules":[{"label":"Contrast","text":"Use nevertheless, nonetheless, conversely, that said, and having said that to manage opposition or qualification.","example":"The data are limited; nevertheless, the trend is clear."},{"label":"Addition and result","text":"Use moreover, furthermore, consequently, accordingly, and for that reason to connect claims precisely.","example":"The method is robust; accordingly, the findings are reliable."},{"label":"Reference and stance","text":"Use in light of this, with this in mind, and taking this into account to link evaluation to prior information.","example":"In light of this, the recommendation remains cautious."}]}

blocks.heading: C2 focus
blocks.body: This compact page anchors the English Sentence Builder C2 lesson on advanced discourse cohesion.

page.title: Paraphrase and Reformulation
page.subtitle_html: Paraphrase and reformulation - C2 precise restatement, clarification, and formal reframing.
page.subtitle_text: C2 precise restatement, clarification, and formal reframing.

blocks.body: {"level":"C2","intro":"Paraphrase and reformulation: compact anchors for restating an argument with greater precision or a different emphasis.","rules":[{"label":"Clarifying restatement","text":"Use in other words, that is to say, and put differently when the second clause sharpens the first.","example":"In other words, the problem lies in a lack of coordination."},{"label":"Reframing","text":"Use reformulation to change focus without changing the core meaning.","example":"The real issue lies not in speed but in quality."},{"label":"Formal precision","text":"Avoid vague repetition; make the new formulation add structure, evidence, or contrast.","example":"This can be understood as a failure of planning rather than execution."}]}
